outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (photoactivation time-lapse images), not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows scatter/line plots of normalized intensity over time (with fitted diffusion model curves) for each construct, including zoomed insets. These are scatter/line-type plots where each point already represents an individual measurement over time rather than a bar/mean requiring overlaid replicates, so this plot type is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
